import asyncio
import time
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Protocol

from .alerts import AlertManager
from .caller import CallerLookup
from .config import Settings
from .providers import (
    Classifier, Email, GeminiClassifier, GradiumSTT, GradiumTTS, ProviderError,
    ResendEmail, Speech, STTSession,
)
from .risk import Assessment, tier


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AgentEvent:
    payload: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    audio: bytes = b""


class AgentSession(Protocol):
    async def send_audio(self, audio: bytes) -> None: ...
    async def receive(self) -> AgentEvent | None: ...
    async def finish(self) -> None: ...
    async def cancel_warning(self) -> None: ...
    async def close(self) -> None: ...


class AgentFactory(Protocol):
    async def open(self, caller: CallerLookup, session_id: str) -> AgentSession: ...


class TranscriptBuffer:
    def __init__(self, limit: int):
        self.limit, self.text, self.truncated = limit, "", False

    def append(self, text: str) -> bool:
        text = text.strip()
        if not text:
            return False
        joined = f"{self.text} {text}".strip()
        if len(joined) > self.limit:
            self.truncated = True
            prefix = self.limit // 3
            joined = joined[:prefix] + " [context clipped] " + joined[-(self.limit - prefix - 19):]
        self.text = joined
        return True


class ScreeningSession:
    def __init__(
        self, settings: Settings, stt: STTSession, classifier: Classifier,
        speech: Speech, email: Email, caller: CallerLookup, session_id: str,
    ):
        self.settings, self.stt, self.classifier, self.speech = settings, stt, classifier, speech
        self.caller = caller
        self.events: asyncio.Queue[AgentEvent | Exception | None] = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=64)
        self.transcript = TranscriptBuffer(settings.transcript_max_chars)
        self.changed = asyncio.Event()
        self.stt_done = asyncio.Event()
        self.assessed = asyncio.Event()
        self.revision = 0
        self.last_revision = 0
        self.latest: Assessment | None = None
        self.warning_attempted = 0
        self.suppressed_until = 0.0
        self.warning_generation = 0
        self.warning_queue: asyncio.Queue[Assessment] = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=1)
        self.alerts = AlertManager(settings, email, session_id, self.activity)
        self.closed = False
        self.tasks = [asyncio.create_task(self._guard(coro)) for coro in (
            self._transcribe(), self._classify(), self._warn(), self.alerts.run(),
        )]

    async def _guard(self, coro: Awaitable[None]) -> None:
        try:
            await coro
        except Exception as exc:
            await self.events.put(exc)

    async def activity(self, tool: str, status: str, detail: str) -> None:
        await self.events.put(AgentEvent({"event": "tool", "tool": tool, "status": status, "detail": detail}))

    async def send_audio(self, audio: bytes) -> None:
        # Continue the stream clock with silence during warning playback, never replay buffered echo.
        if time.monotonic() < self.suppressed_until:
            audio = bytes(len(audio))
        await self.stt.send_audio(audio)

    async def receive(self) -> AgentEvent | None:
        event = await self.events.get()
        if isinstance(event, Exception):
            raise event
        return event

    async def _transcribe(self) -> None:
        await self.activity("stt", "streaming", "Gradium STT connected; streaming microphone audio.")
        while True:
            event = await asyncio.wait_for(self.stt.receive(), self.settings.provider_idle_timeout_seconds)
            if event is None:
                self.stt_done.set()
                return
            if event.kind == "text" and self.transcript.append(event.text):
                self.revision += 1
                self.assessed.clear()
                self.changed.set()
            # end_text closes a segment; it is not another text chunk. flushed is an
            # acknowledgement, not permission to discard the accumulated conversation.

    async def _classify(self) -> None:
        last_started = 0.0
        while True:
            await self.changed.wait()
            delay = max(0.0, self.settings.classification_interval_seconds - (time.monotonic() - last_started))
            if delay:
                await asyncio.sleep(delay)
            self.changed.clear()
            revision, text = self.revision, self.transcript.text
            last_started = time.monotonic()
            await self.activity("gemini", "assessing", "Assessing accumulated call context.")
            try:
                async with asyncio.timeout(self.settings.request_timeout_seconds):
                    assessment = await self.classifier.classify(text, self.caller)
            except (ProviderError, ValueError, TimeoutError):
                await self.events.put(AgentEvent({"event": "assessment_unavailable", "revision": revision}))
                await self.activity("gemini", "error", "Assessment unavailable. No score or warning fabricated.")
            else:
                # One classifier request at a time; revisions can never arrive out of order.
                self.latest = assessment
                await self.events.put(AgentEvent({
                    "event": "assessment", "revision": revision,
                    **assessment.model_dump(), "context_truncated": self.transcript.truncated,
                }))
                await self.activity("gemini", "complete", "Six criteria assessed; screening indicator updated.")
                await self.alerts.consider(assessment, self.caller)
                if self.warning_queue.full():
                    self.warning_queue.get_nowait()
                    self.warning_queue.task_done()
                self.warning_queue.put_nowait(assessment)
            self.last_revision = revision
            if revision == self.revision:
                self.assessed.set()

    async def _warn(self) -> None:
        while True:
            assessment = await self.warning_queue.get()
            try:
                level = max(1, tier(assessment.overall))
                if (not assessment.warning_text or assessment.overall < self.settings.warning_threshold
                    or level <= self.warning_attempted):
                    continue
                self.warning_attempted = level
                generation = self.warning_generation
                await self.activity("tts", "synthesizing", "Gradium TTS is synthesizing an eligible caution.")
                try:
                    async with asyncio.timeout(self.settings.request_timeout_seconds):
                        audio = await self.speech.synthesize(assessment.warning_text)
                    if not audio or len(audio) % 2 or len(audio) > 12 * 96000:
                        raise ProviderError("tts", "invalid_audio")
                except (ProviderError, TimeoutError):
                    await self.activity("tts", "error", "Warning audio unavailable; scores remain visible.")
                    continue
                if (generation != self.warning_generation or self.latest is None
                    or self.latest.overall < self.settings.warning_threshold):
                    await self.activity("tts", "cancelled", "Outdated warning discarded.")
                    continue
                duration = len(audio) / 96000
                self.suppressed_until = time.monotonic() + duration + 1
                await self.events.put(AgentEvent({
                    "event": "warning", "text": assessment.warning_text,
                    "duration_seconds": duration,
                }, audio))
                await self.activity("tts", "ready", "Warning audio sent to browser; playback depends on browser audio.")
                # Bound warning cadence and prevent a second warning overlapping playback.
                await asyncio.sleep(duration + 1)
            finally:
                self.warning_queue.task_done()

    async def cancel_warning(self) -> None:
        self.warning_generation += 1
        # A short tail protects against sound already emitted by laptop speakers.
        self.suppressed_until = time.monotonic() + 0.5
        await self.events.put(AgentEvent({"event": "clear"}))
        await self.activity("tts", "cancelled", "Warning cancelled by listener.")

    async def finish(self) -> None:
        # End-session drains STT; pause/disconnect cancels immediately via close().
        await self.stt.finish()
        await self.stt_done.wait()
        if self.revision > self.last_revision:
            await self.assessed.wait()
        await self.alerts.pending.join()
        await self.warning_queue.join()

    async def close(self) -> None:
        if self.closed:
            return
        self.closed = True
        for task in self.tasks:
            task.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*self.tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        await self.stt.close()
        self.transcript.text = ""
        self.latest = None
        while not self.events.empty():
            self.events.get_nowait()


class ScreeningFactory:
    def __init__(
        self, settings: Settings, *,
        stt_open: Callable[[], Awaitable[STTSession]] | None = None,
        classifier: Classifier | None = None, speech: Speech | None = None,
        email: Email | None = None,
    ):
        self.settings = settings
        self.stt_open = stt_open or (lambda: GradiumSTT.open(settings))
        self.classifier = classifier or GeminiClassifier(settings)
        self.speech = speech or GradiumTTS(settings)
        self.email = email or ResendEmail(settings)

    async def open(self, caller: CallerLookup, session_id: str) -> AgentSession:
        stt = await self.stt_open()
        return ScreeningSession(self.settings, stt, self.classifier, self.speech, self.email, caller, session_id)

"""Bounded full-duplex browser PCM transport and screening-session lifecycle."""

import asyncio
import json
import logging
import time
import uuid
from contextlib import suppress

from anyio import CancelScope
from fastapi import WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect

from .agent import AgentFactory, AgentSession
from .caller import CallerLookup, lookup_caller
from .config import Settings

INPUT_RATE = 24000
OUTPUT_RATE = 48000
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


class ProtocolError(ValueError):
    pass


async def read_start(ws: WebSocket, settings: Settings) -> CallerLookup:
    message = await asyncio.wait_for(ws.receive(), 5)
    if message["type"] == "websocket.disconnect":
        raise WebSocketDisconnect(message.get("code", 1000))
    raw = message.get("text", "")
    if len(raw) > 1024:
        raise ProtocolError("Start message too large")
    start = json.loads(raw)
    if not isinstance(start, dict):
        raise ProtocolError("Expected start object")
    number = start.pop("caller_number", "")
    if not isinstance(number, str) or len(number) > 64:
        raise ProtocolError("Invalid caller number")
    if start != {"event": "start", "encoding": "pcm_s16le", "sample_rate": INPUT_RATE, "channels": 1}:
        raise ProtocolError("Expected mono 24kHz PCM16 start")
    return await asyncio.to_thread(lookup_caller, number, settings.caller_default_region, settings.scam_db_path)


async def relay(
    ws: WebSocket, settings: Settings, factory: AgentFactory, session_id: str, caller: CallerLookup,
) -> None:
    started = time.monotonic()
    session: AgentSession | None = None
    tasks: list[asyncio.Task] = []
    incoming: asyncio.Queue[bytes] = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=128)
    finish_requested = asyncio.Event()
    provider_ready = asyncio.Event()

    async def receive_microphone() -> None:
        while True:
            message = await asyncio.wait_for(ws.receive(), settings.media_idle_timeout_seconds)
            if message["type"] == "websocket.disconnect":
                return
            if "text" in message:
                raw = message["text"]
                if len(raw) > 1024:
                    raise ProtocolError("Control message too large")
                control = json.loads(raw)
                if control == {"event": "stop"}:
                    return
                if control == {"event": "finish"}:
                    finish_requested.set()
                    await provider_ready.wait()
                    await incoming.join()
                    assert session is not None
                    await asyncio.wait_for(session.finish(), settings.request_timeout_seconds + 15)
                    # Let the sender deliver the final bounded result before closing.
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
                    return
                if control == {"event": "cancel_warning"} and session is not None:
                    await session.cancel_warning()
                    continue
                raise ProtocolError("Unexpected control message")
            audio = message.get("bytes", b"")
            if not 0 < len(audio) <= 9600 or len(audio) % 2:
                raise ProtocolError("Expected at most 200ms of PCM16")
            try:
                incoming.put_nowait(audio)
            except asyncio.QueueFull as exc:
                raise ProtocolError("Microphone queue overflow") from exc

    async def forward_audio() -> None:
        assert session is not None
        while True:
            audio = await incoming.get()
            try:
                await asyncio.wait_for(session.send_audio(audio), 5)
            finally:
                incoming.task_done()

    async def send_agent() -> None:
        assert session is not None
        while True:
            event = await session.receive()
            if event is None:
                return
            if event.payload:
                await asyncio.wait_for(ws.send_json(event.payload), 5)
            for offset in range(0, len(event.audio), 1920):
                await asyncio.wait_for(ws.send_bytes(event.audio[offset:offset + 1920]), 5)

    async def run_provider() -> None:
        nonlocal session
        session = await asyncio.wait_for(factory.open(caller, session_id), settings.session_start_timeout_seconds)
        await asyncio.wait_for(ws.send_json({
            "event": "ready", "input_rate": INPUT_RATE, "output_rate": OUTPUT_RATE,
            "caller": caller.public(), "email_status": settings.email_status(),
        }), 5)
        provider_ready.set()
        provider_tasks = [asyncio.create_task(coro()) for coro in (forward_audio, send_agent)]
        try:
            done, _ = await asyncio.wait(provider_tasks, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
            for task in done:
                task.result()
        finally:
            for task in provider_tasks:
                task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(*provider_tasks, return_exceptions=True)

    try:
        async with asyncio.timeout(settings.max_session_seconds):
            tasks = [asyncio.create_task(receive_microphone()), asyncio.create_task(run_provider())]
            done, _ = await asyncio.wait(tasks, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)
            for task in done:
                task.result()
    finally:
        with CancelScope(shield=True):
            for task in tasks:
                task.cancel()
            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
            if session is not None:
                with suppress(Exception):
                    await asyncio.wait_for(session.close(), 3)
            log.info("screening_closed id=%s duration_s=%.2f", session_id, time.monotonic() - started)


class SessionRegistry:
    def __init__(self, limit: int):
        self.limit = limit
        self.sockets: set[WebSocket] = set()
        self.draining = False

    def acquire(self, ws: WebSocket) -> bool:
        if self.draining or len(self.sockets) >= self.limit:
            return False
        self.sockets.add(ws)
        return True

    async def shutdown(self) -> None:
        self.draining = True
        for ws in list(self.sockets):
            with suppress(Exception):
                await ws.close(code=1001)


async def handle_stream(ws: WebSocket, settings: Settings, factory: AgentFactory, registry: SessionRegistry) -> None:
    if not registry.acquire(ws):
        await ws.close(code=1013)
        return
    session_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    code, reason = 1000, "session-ended"
    try:
        await ws.accept()
        caller = await read_start(ws, settings)
        log.info("screening_started id=%s active=%d", session_id, len(registry.sockets))
        await relay(ws, settings, factory, session_id, caller)
    except WebSocketDisconnect:
        pass
    except (ProtocolError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError):
        code, reason = 1008, "invalid-audio"
        log.warning("screening_protocol_error id=%s", session_id)
    except TimeoutError:
        code, reason = 1011, "session-timeout"
        log.warning("screening_timeout id=%s", session_id)
    except Exception as exc:
        code, reason = 1011, "provider-unavailable"
        log.error("screening_provider_error id=%s type=%s", session_id, type(exc).__name__)
    finally:
        registry.sockets.discard(ws)
        with suppress(Exception):
            await ws.close(code=code, reason=reason)

head='''# Scam the Scamers

A local call-screening companion. Answer a call on your phone, turn on
speakerphone, and place your laptop nearby. The browser microphone sends audio
through the backend to Gradium STT. Gemini scores six warning signs; scores
update quietly. Only eligible caution text is sent to Gradium TTS and played aloud.
There are no greetings or open-ended agent replies.

## Getting started

Requires [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/). Setup installs
Python 3.12 and the application dependencies.

```bash
scripts/setup.sh
# Privately add GRADIUM_API_KEY and GEMINI_API_KEY (or existing LLM_API_KEY) to .env.
scripts/run_local.sh
```

Open **http://localhost:8082**. Optionally enter the caller's phone number, check the
fallback email status, click **Enable listener**, and allow microphone access.
Keep the tab open and computer awake. Sound above the adjustable threshold for
180 ms starts screening; a bounded pre-roll preserves the start of speech.
Ringing or music can trigger it. The app cannot detect call acceptance or caller ID.

The responsive workspace offers **Split view**, **Listener** and **Tools & activity**.
Switching views does not interrupt audio. Scores start as waiting, never invented zeroes.
Actual Gradium STT, Gemini, SQLite lookup, Gradium TTS and Resend results/errors appear
in the activity panel. The most recent 60 events stay only in page memory.

**End screening** flushes the last audio/text and returns to waiting. After 30 seconds
of quiet the browser also finalizes the session. **Pause listener** immediately
cancels work, stops playback and releases the microphone. The server enforces a
session time limit, provider/media timeouts and a concurrency limit.

## Scores and warnings

Criterion scores describe evidence strength: 0 absent, 25 ambiguous, 50 plausible,
75 strong, 100 explicit. They are model judgments, not calibrated probabilities.
The overall screening indicator is the weighted sum below, rounded to one decimal.
Gemini must return all six scores and the overall; invalid or inconsistent responses
show unavailable, without fabricating scores or speech.

| Criterion | Example | Overall weight |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| Family-member claim | “I'm your daughter.” | 5% |
| Emotional distress | “I've been arrested.” | 10% |
| Urgency | “Within the hour.” | 20% |
| Secrecy | “Don't tell Mum and Dad.” | 20% |
| Financial request | “CHF 5,000 in cash.” | 25% |
| Courier pickup | “Someone will collect the cash.” | 20% |

A family claim by itself contributes at most **5/100**. Each criterion and the overall
use green below 50, amber from 50, red from 75 and critical from 90. Higher values
warrant caution and independent verification; they do not establish fraud. A criterion
can have strong evidence without the whole call being suspicious. The rubric needs
real-world calibration and may miss other scam patterns.

Default `WARNING_THRESHOLD=50` controls spoken cautions independently of email tiers.
Gemini may return no warning text, even at high scores; this never triggers TTS.
Eligible text must be one of three short caution phrases defined in `risk.py`, preventing
caller-injected instructions from being spoken. Each reached warning tier is attempted
at most once per session; failed/cancelled warnings are not repeatedly synthesized.
**Stop warning audio** cancels playback. Echo cancellation plus bounded silence forwarding
in the browser/backend prevents warning audio from feeding back into the classifier.
Speech overlapping a warning can be missed; real speakerphone acoustic testing is still
required. A browser audio error pauses the listener with an actionable message.

## Caller number lookup

The optional number is supplied by you, never detected. International `+` numbers
are supported; national numbers default to **Switzerland (`CALLER_DEFAULT_REGION=CH`)**.
For example `079 123 45 67` becomes `+41791234567`, not a US number. Use an explicit
international prefix for other countries or configure the default ISO region.

The existing [dataset and provenance](data/scam_numbers/README.md) are preserved and
queried locally with read-only, parameterized SQLite. The wheel includes the database;
`SCAM_DB_PATH` can explicitly override its location. UI states distinguish omitted,
invalid, matched, no match and unavailable. A match includes source/import time and
may be stale; caller ID can be spoofed. No match is **not** proof of safety. Lookup
status is explicit Gemini context, with no automatic numerical score bonus.

## Fallback email via Resend

Set these privately in `.env`, then restart the server:

```dotenv
RESEND_API_KEY=
ALERT_FROM_EMAIL=
FALLBACK_EMAIL=
```

Use a plain sender address verified in your Resend account and one valid recipient.
The local UI displays the configured fallback address before listening. Missing or
invalid configuration is clearly marked and does not prevent screening. Once configured,
starting the listener enables automatic runtime alerts; the browser cannot supply a
recipient, sender or arbitrary email body.

A first crossing of 50 sends a caution; reaching 75 or 90 escalates. A direct jump to
90 sends one critical alert. Repeated scores and falling/rising jitter do not resend
previous tiers. Pending unsent escalations coalesce to the highest. Attempted and
API-accepted tiers are tracked separately in session memory. Transport failures, 429
and 5xx receive at most **one retry after one second**, using the same idempotency key
and exact payload; a newer pending tier supersedes the retry. Authentication/validation
failures are not retried. No repeated retry on each transcript. New sessions have new
identities, so they may alert again; restarting is not a delivery recovery mechanism.

Emails contain severity, UTC time, caller context and criterion scores, without raw
transcripts. “Accepted by Resend” is not verified inbox delivery. No delivery webhook
is installed. **Development and `doctor --live` never send real email**; transport tests
use fakes. Email credentials and a separately authorized delivery test remain needed.

## Configuration and privacy

`.env.example` lists supported options. Existing `LLM_API_KEY` remains valid;
`GEMINI_API_KEY` takes precedence when nonempty. Existing Google configuration is
preserved: `LLM_BASE_URL=https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai` and
`LLM_MODEL=gemini-3.5-flash-lite`. Only Google's compatible endpoint and Gemini models
are accepted; there is no fallback to another LLM. API keys stay on the server.

```bash
uv run scam-the-scamers doctor         # Configuration only; no network or email
uv run scam-the-scamers doctor --live  # Bounded synthetic Gemini/Gradium probes; API credits
```

Defaults: one session, five-minute cap, 20-second HTTP request timeout, 45-second STT
heartbeat timeout, 20-second media timeout and 1.5 seconds between classification
starts. No first-TTS timeout exists: low-risk sessions can remain silent throughout.
`FIRST_AUDIO_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` is obsolete and ignored for env compatibility.

STT uses 24 kHz PCM in 80 ms frames and flushes after a short acoustic pause. Text
segments accumulate; `end_text` and `flushed` are boundaries, not duplicate text.
One Gemini request runs at a time, coalescing new text and ordering assessments by
revision. Context is bounded to 12,000 characters; after clipping, the opening third
and latest conversation are retained and the UI discloses truncation. This can lose
middle context on long calls. Provider failures produce an unavailable assessment;
new speech can trigger the next attempt. Pause/disconnect cancels in-flight work.

While waiting, audio stays in the browser. During screening, Gradium processes audio,
Google processes bounded transcript/lookup context, and configured Resend alerts process
the risk summary and contact addresses. The app does not store or log audio/transcripts;
provider retention policies are separate. Classification uses stateless chat requests,
without provider conversation IDs. Contacts and keys are not committed. Same-origin
WebSockets, loopback Host checks, CSP, bounded queues/messages and timeout cleanup remain.

Provider formats were verified against official documentation:
[Gradium STT](https://docs.gradium.ai/guides/speech-to-text),
[Gradium lifecycle](https://docs.gradium.ai/guides/websocket-lifecycle),
[Gradium TTS](https://docs.gradium.ai/guides/text-to-speech-rest),
[Gemini compatible structured output](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/openai#structured-output),
[Resend send email and idempotency](https://resend.com/docs/api-reference/emails/send-email).
The Google-compatible JSON-schema endpoint was selected to preserve the configured
endpoint/model and verified with actual requests; no Interactions conversation is created.

## Repository and verification

`providers.py` owns concrete network adapters; `agent.py` orchestrates injected providers;
`risk.py` defines validation/rubric; `alerts.py` manages delivery tiers; `caller.py` wraps
